description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—in relation extraction tasks as a function of the number of samples generated. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values of 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis measures the Micro F1 score, a metric for the accuracy of the relation extraction, ranging from approximately 25% to 52%. The TACRED method is represented by a blue line with circle markers, the TACRED-Revisit method by an orange line with triangle markers, the Re-TACRED method by a green line with diamond markers, and the SemEval method by a red line with star markers. The plot shows that the Micro F1 score for all methods increases as the number of samples generated increases, with the SemEval method consistently performing the best across all sample sizes, followed by Re-TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, and TACRED. The plot does not include any inferences or conclusions about the cause of the changes in performance.
